literal_frozen_caller_definitions.c1_reference_image:
c1_reference_image (file_bytes:num->byte)
     (initial_rw:int64->byte) (padding:int64->byte) (a:int64) =
    if c1_immutable (val a) then file_bytes (val a - 0x21000000)
    else if c1_initialized_rw (val a) then initial_rw a else padding a
literal_frozen_caller_definitions.c1_full_image:
c1_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding (m:int64->byte) <=>
    !a. c1_image_domain (val a)
        ==> m a = c1_reference_image file_bytes initial_rw padding a
literal_frozen_caller_definitions.c1_file_code:
c1_file_code (file_bytes:num->byte) <=>
    (!i. i<22 ==> file_bytes(0x1110+i)=EL i c1_crypto_caller_mc) /\
    (!i. i<6 ==> file_bytes(0x1030+i)=EL i c1_crypto_plt_prefix)
literal_frozen_caller_definitions.c1_loaded_code:
c1_loaded_code (s:x86state) <=>
    bytes_loaded s (word 0x21001110) c1_crypto_caller_mc /\
    bytes_loaded s (word 0x21001030) c1_crypto_plt_prefix /\
    bytes_loaded s (word 0x10241840) crypto_memcmp_mc
literal_frozen_caller_definitions.c1_allowed_read:
c1_allowed_read rp ordinary stackpointer p q n a <=>
    rp a /\ ordinary a /\
    (assurance_region p n a \/ assurance_region q n a \/
     c1_call_slot stackpointer a \/ assurance_region stackpointer 8 a \/
     assurance_region (word 0x21003fd8) 8 a)
literal_frozen_caller_definitions.c1_allowed_write:
c1_allowed_write wp ordinary stackpointer a <=>
    wp a /\ ordinary a /\ c1_call_slot stackpointer a
literal_frozen_caller_definitions.c1_allowed_fetch:
c1_allowed_fetch xp ordinary a <=>
    xp a /\ ordinary a /\
    (assurance_region (word 0x21001110) 22 a \/
     assurance_region (word 0x21001030) 6 a \/
     assurance_region (word 0x10241840) 95 a)
literal_frozen_caller_definitions.c1_frame:
c1_frame stackpointer =
    MAYCHANGE [RIP;RSP;RAX;RDI;RSI;RDX;R10;R11] ,,
    MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
    MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes(word_sub stackpointer (word 16),8)] ,,
    MAYCHANGE [events]
literal_frozen_caller_definitions.c1_pre:
c1_pre lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
    stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary
    (s:x86state,a:abi_omitted_state) <=>
    n<2 EXP 64 /\ 16<=val(stackpointer:int64) /\
    val stackpointer MOD 16=8 /\ val stackpointer+8<2 EXP 64 /\
    assurance_canonical48(val(ra:int64)) /\ ~(ra=word 0x21001110) /\
    read RIP s=word 0x21001110 /\ read RSP s=stackpointer /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s=ra /\
    C_ARGUMENTS [p;q;word n] s /\ read memory s=m /\
    read DF s=F /\ ~bit 18(read rflags s) /\ e5_normal_flags s /\
    assurance_canonical48(val(read ABI_FS_BASE a)) /\
    fb_file_code lib_file /\ fb_full_image lib_file lib_rw lib_padding m /\
    c1_file_code client_file /\
    c1_full_image client_file client_rw client_padding m /\
    c1_loaded_code s /\ c1_got s /\
    (!addr. lw_image_domain addr ==>
       rp addr /\ ordinary addr /\ (xp addr <=> lw_execute addr) /\
       (wp addr <=> lw_image_write addr)) /\
    (!addr. c1_image_domain addr ==>
       rp addr /\ ordinary addr /\ (xp addr <=> c1_image_execute addr) /\
       (wp addr <=> c1_image_write addr)) /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val p) n /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val q) n /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val stackpointer-16) 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. wp a /\ ordinary a) (val stackpointer-16) 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val stackpointer) 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) 0x21003fd8 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) 0x21001110 22 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) 0x21001030 6 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) 0x10241840 95 /\
    (!addr. ~(assurance_region p n addr /\ c1_call_slot stackpointer addr)) /\
    (!addr. ~(assurance_region q n addr /\ c1_call_slot stackpointer addr)) /\
    (!addr. ~(assurance_region stackpointer 8 addr /\
              c1_call_slot stackpointer addr))
literal_frozen_caller_definitions.c1_scalar_post:
c1_scalar_post stackpointer ra p q n m (s:x86state) t <=>
    read RIP t=ra /\ val(read RSP t)=val(stackpointer:int64)+8 /\
    read RAX t=(if (!i. i<n ==> m(word_add p (word i))=
                                  m(word_add q (word i)))
                then word 1 else word 0) /\
    (!addr. ~c1_call_slot stackpointer (val addr)
            ==> read memory t addr=m addr) /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) t=ra /\
    read RBX t=read RBX s /\ read RBP t=read RBP s /\
    read R12 t=read R12 s /\ read R13 t=read R13 s /\
    read R14 t=read R14 s /\ read R15 t=read R15 s /\
    read DF t=F /\ c1_loaded_code t /\ c1_got t /\
    c1_frame stackpointer s t
literal_frozen_caller_definitions.c1_public_post:
c1_public_post stackpointer ra p q n m s a
    (t:x86state#abi_omitted_state) <=>
    c1_scalar_post stackpointer ra p q n m s (FST t) /\
    SND t=a /\ abi_required_controls_preserved a (SND t)
literal_frozen_caller_definitions.c1_segment_policy:
c1_segment_policy stackpointer p q n rp wp xp ordinary
    remaining source target <=>
    assurance_step_policy
      (c1_allowed_read rp ordinary stackpointer p q n)
      (c1_allowed_write wp ordinary stackpointer)
      (c1_allowed_fetch xp ordinary) source target /\
    abi_all_decodes_caller_scalar source
literal_frozen_caller_definitions.c1_step_policy:
c1_step_policy stackpointer p q n rp wp xp ordinary
    remaining source target <=>
    c1_segment_policy stackpointer p q n rp wp xp ordinary
      remaining source target /\
    (remaining=1 ==> assurance_actual_ret 1 source target)
literal_frozen_caller_definitions.c1_prefix_frame:
c1_prefix_frame stackpointer =
    MAYCHANGE [RIP;RSP] ,, MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
    MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes(word_sub stackpointer (word 16),8)] ,,
    MAYCHANGE [events]
literal_frozen_caller_definitions.c1_crypto_ready:
c1_crypto_ready lib_file stackpointer p q n m rp xp ordinary
    (s:x86state) a (t:x86state) <=>
    bp_e2_crypto_public_pre lib_file (read memory t) (read memory t)
      (word_sub stackpointer (word 16)) (word 0x21001119) p q n
      (read memory t) rp xp ordinary (t,a) /\
    (!addr. ~c1_call_slot stackpointer (val addr)
            ==> read memory t addr=m addr) /\
    (!i. i<n ==> read memory t (word_add p (word i))=m(word_add p (word i))) /\
    (!i. i<n ==> read memory t (word_add q (word i))=m(word_add q (word i))) /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) t=
      read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s /\
    c1_loaded_code t /\ c1_got t /\ c1_prefix_frame stackpointer s t

assurance_checked_run.literal_equation:
(assurance_checked_run 0 (P:x86state->bool)
      (C:num->x86state->x86state->bool) s <=> P s) /\
  (assurance_checked_run (SUC n) P C s <=>
     (?s'. x86 s s') /\
     !s'. x86 s s' ==> C (SUC n) s s' /\
                        assurance_checked_run n P C s')

assurance_step_policy.literal_equation:
assurance_step_policy rp wp xp (s:x86state) (s':x86state) <=>
   ?len inst d.
     x86_decode s (read RIP s) (len,inst) /\
     assurance_span_ok xp (val(read RIP s)) len /\
     read events s' = APPEND d (read events s) /\
     ALL (assurance_event_policy rp wp) d

assurance_zero_step.literal_equation:
assurance_zero_step rp wp xp remaining s s' <=>
   assurance_step_policy rp wp xp s s' /\
   (remaining = 1 ==> assurance_actual_ret 2 s s')

assurance_canonical48.literal_equation:
assurance_canonical48 a <=>
    a < 2 EXP 64 /\ (a < 2 EXP 47 \/ 2 EXP 64 - 2 EXP 47 <= a)

assurance_region.literal_equation: assurance_region (p:int64) n a <=> val p <= a /\ a < val p+n

assurance_span_ok.literal_equation:
assurance_span_ok perm a width <=>
    a+width <= 2 EXP 64 /\
    !j. j < width ==> assurance_canonical48 (a+j) /\ perm(a+j)

assurance_event_policy.literal_equation:
assurance_event_policy rp wp e <=>
    match e with
    | EventLoad(adr,width) -> assurance_span_ok rp (val adr) width
    | EventStore(adr,width) -> assurance_span_ok wp (val adr) width
    | _ -> T

assurance_fetch_policy.literal_equation:
assurance_fetch_policy xp
      (obs:int64#num#instruction#uarch_event list) <=>
    assurance_span_ok xp (val(FST obs)) (FST(SND obs))

assurance_actual_ret.literal_equation:
assurance_actual_ret len (s:x86state) (s':x86state) <=>
    x86_decode s (read RIP s) (len,RET) /\
    (RIP := word_add (read RIP s) (word len) ,, x86_RET) s s'

e5_rf_retired_step.literal_equation:
e5_rf_retired_step (s:x86state) t <=>
    ?u. x86 s u /\ t=e5_rf_clear u

e5_rf_retired_extended_step.literal_equation:

          t=(e5_rf_clear u,b)

e5_normal_step_policy.literal_equation:
e5_normal_step_policy (C:num->x86state->x86state->bool) k s t <=>
    C k s t /\ e5_normal_flags s /\ e5_normal_flags t

e5_normal_environment.literal_equation:

e5_rf_checked_run.literal_equation:

(r1_indirect_operand (% r) <=> true) /\

expanded_definitions.name: bp_e2_cleanse_call_post
expanded_definitions.statement:
forall m pc stackpointer ra p n s t.
    bp_e2_cleanse_call_post pc stackpointer ra p n m s t <=>
    read RIP t = ra /\
    val (read RSP t) = val stackpointer + 8 /\
    (forall i. i < n ==> read memory t (word_add p (word i)) = word 0) /\
    (forall a. ~assurance_region p n (val a) ==> read memory t a = m a) /\
    bytes_loaded t (word pc) openssl_cleanse_mc /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) t = ra /\
    (MAYCHANGE [RIP; RSP; RAX; RDI; RSI] ,,
     MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
     MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes (p,n)] ,,
     MAYCHANGE [events])
    s

expanded_definitions.name: bp_e2_cleanse_pre
expanded_definitions.statement:
forall m ra s xp rp wp ordinary pc p n stackpointer.
    bp_e2_cleanse_pre pc stackpointer ra p n m rp wp xp ordinary s <=>
    n < 2 EXP 64 /\
    pc + 97 <= 2 EXP 64 /\
    bytes_loaded s (word pc) openssl_cleanse_mc /\
    read RIP s = word pc /\
    read RSP s = stackpointer /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s = ra /\
    C_ARGUMENTS [p; word n] s /\
    read memory s = m /\
    val stackpointer MOD 16 = 8 /\
    val stackpointer + 8 < 2 EXP 64 /\
    assurance_canonical48 (val ra) /\
    ~(ra = word pc) /\
    (read DF s <=> false) /\
    ~bit 18 (read rflags s) /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) pc 97 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val stackpointer) 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. wp a /\ ordinary a) (val p) n /\
    (forall a. ~(assurance_region p n a /\ assurance_region (word pc) 97 a)) /\
    (forall a.
         ~(assurance_region p n a /\ assurance_region stackpointer 8 a))

expanded_definitions.name: cleanse_functional_steps
expanded_definitions.statement:
forall n p.
    cleanse_functional_steps p n =
    (if n < 15
     then 4 * n + 7
     else let a = (8 - val p MOD 8) MOD 8 in
          9 + 6 * a + 5 * (n - a) DIV 8 + 4 * (n - a) MOD 8)

expanded_definitions.name: cleanse_access_count
expanded_definitions.statement:
forall n p.
    cleanse_access_count p n =
    (if n < 15
     then 4 * n + 7
     else let a = (8 - val p MOD 8) MOD 8 in
          let k = (n - a) DIV 8 in
          let r = (n - a) MOD 8 in 9 + 6 * a + 5 * k + 4 * r)

expanded_definitions.name: cleanse_access_covered_step
expanded_definitions.statement:
forall rp wp xp remaining s' pc s.
    cleanse_access_covered_step pc rp wp xp remaining s s' <=>
    assurance_zero_step rp wp xp remaining s s' /\
    (exists off len inst.
         read RIP s = word (pc + off) /\
         abi_cleanse_site off len inst /\
         x86_decode s (read RIP s) (len,inst))

    bytes_loaded s (word pc) openssl_cleanse_mc

expanded_definitions.name: assurance_checked_run
expanded_definitions.statement:
(assurance_checked_run 0 P C s <=> P s) /\
(assurance_checked_run (SUC n) P C s <=>
 (exists s'. x86 s s') /\
 (forall s'. x86 s s' ==> C (SUC n) s s' /\ assurance_checked_run n P C s'))

expanded_definitions.name: assurance_step_policy
expanded_definitions.statement:
forall xp s' s rp wp.
    assurance_step_policy rp wp xp s s' <=>
    (exists len inst d.
         x86_decode s (read RIP s) (len,inst) /\
         assurance_span_ok xp (val (read RIP s)) len /\
         read events s' = APPEND d (read events s) /\
         ALL (assurance_event_policy rp wp) d)

expanded_definitions.name: assurance_zero_step
expanded_definitions.statement:
forall rp wp xp remaining s s'.
    assurance_zero_step rp wp xp remaining s s' <=>
    assurance_step_policy rp wp xp s s' /\
    (remaining = 1 ==> assurance_actual_ret 2 s s')

expanded_definitions.name: assurance_event_policy
expanded_definitions.statement:
forall e rp wp.
    assurance_event_policy rp wp e <=>
    (match e with
       EventLoad (adr,width) -> assurance_span_ok rp (val adr) width
     | EventStore (adr,width) -> assurance_span_ok wp (val adr) width
     | _ -> true)

expanded_definitions.statement:

expanded_definitions.name: assurance_span_ok

    a + width <= 2 EXP 64 /\
    (forall j. j < width ==> assurance_canonical48 (a + j) /\ perm (a + j))

expanded_definitions.name: assurance_canonical48
expanded_definitions.statement:

    a < 2 EXP 64 /\ (a < 2 EXP 47 \/ 2 EXP 64 - 2 EXP 47 <= a)

    read ABI_FS_SELECTOR a' = read ABI_FS_SELECTOR a /\
